Variable Frequency Digital Controller for Vibratory Feeder  **SDVC31 Series** ## Appendix F: Trouble Shooting Tips and Error Explanations The following tips can help to solve the problems you may encounter | No. | Problem / display | 数码管符号图片 | Trouble Shooting Tips and Error Explanations | |---:|---|---|---| | 1 | No display after
power on | | ◆ Make sure the power outlet is live
◆ Make sure the Input Power Cable is reliably connected to the power outlet | | 2 | Displays normally
but no output | | ◆ Make sure the Input Power Cable and Output Power Cable are firmly connected
◆ Make sure the Output Voltage parameter value is not too small
◆ Make sure the controller is not stopped by the control signal
◆ Make sure the controller is not stopped by the parameters that are set as normal off | | 3 | Control signal
loses effectiveness | | ◆ Make sure the control signal is correctly inputted
◆ Make sure the ground wire of the control signal is correctly connected to the controller
◆ Make sure the Logical Relation of the control signal is set correctly as you expectation | | 4 | Beat phenomena | | ◆ Avoid vibration coupling among the vibrators
◆ Heighten the resonant frequency of the vibrators | | 5 | Displays normally,
no output, but sound
can be heard | | ◆ Adjust all parameters as this book instructed | | 6 | Err01 | [[vcrop:46:0]] | ◆ Output in short-circuit, Make sure the Output Power Cable and the coil are not shorted out | | 7 | Err02 | [[vcrop:46:1]] | ◆ Output Over current, Reduce the Output Voltage value and make sure the armature gap is not too big | | 8 | Err03 | [[vcrop:46:2]] | ◆ Overheat, Place the controller in well ventilated environment | | 9 | Err04 | [[vcrop:46:3]] | ◆ Reserved, please contact us | | 10 | Err05 | [[vcrop:46:4]] | ◆ Reserved, please contact us | 2018-11  -38-  SDVC31SMSEN_3.01
